name: resume-src
description: Generates the resume .docx, web page and PDF from resume-data.js

scripts.build: node make-docx.js && node make-resume-html.js && cp resume.html ../resume/index.html && cp Dwight_Banks_Resume.docx .. && "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" --headless=new --disable-gpu --no-pdf-header-footer --print-to-pdf="$PWD/../Dwight_Banks_Resume.pdf" "file://$PWD/resume.html"
